messages:
maria: Quick mini-poll — office fruit restock this week: apples 🍎 or bananas 🍌? Also second question: keep the new filtered-water dispenser or keep the old jug? Reply with ‘apple’/‘banana’ and ‘dispenser’/‘jug’. I’ll tally.
ben: apple + dispenser :thumbsup:
jamal: banana + jug
sophia: apple + dispenser — but honestly I’ll take either lol
kai: banana (for speed) + dispenser (less glass clanking) :grin:
ben: also can we please get a sticker that says ‘I peaked at snack table’ ?
maria: noted re: stickers 😂 maybe for next swag drop
ops-bot: poll recorded: 4 responses so far
jamal: quick follow — anyone allergic to bananas? (we'll avoid ordering giant tray if yes)
sophia: not allergic but allergic to mornings before coffee, which is basically the same thing
maria: no banana allergies reported. current tally: apples 2, bananas 2; dispenser 3, jug 1
kai: tie on fruit, but dispenser wins. can we do half-case apple + bunch of bananas? equilibrium achieved
ben: yes please half-and-half
maria: ordering plan: 12 apples, 1 large bunch of bananas, replace jug with filtered dispenser (trial for 2 weeks). thanks folks :sparkles:
jamal: bless you, maria
sophia: hero of hydration and fruit
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: check dispenser feedback in 14 days
